items.title: Call to Order
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman called the meeting to order at 9:00 a.m.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman provided a land acknowledgement.

items.title: Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
Strategic Planning Workshop - Heather Russek, and Jessica Thornton, Creative Futures
notes:
Heather Russek, and Jessica Thornton, Creative Futures, led Council through a workshop on the priorities for the 2023-2027 strategic plan. They highlighted the themes that they have heard from Council and the public throughout the planning process. They presented possible strategic priorities based on those themes.  

J. Liggett joined the meeting at 9:17 a.m.

Council recessed at 10:47 a.m. and reconvened at 11:10 a.m.

items.title: Mission, Vision and Values - Rebecca Sutherns
notes:
Rebecca Sutherns led Council through a workshop on developing the mission, vision, and values.

D. McCabe left the meeting at 11:45 a.m.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 12:21 p.m.
